EDIT 01

The Instant Glow Edit

For the friend who wants that fresh-from-a-facial look before a night out

Know someone who loves looking like they've just stepped out of a facial? This is the gift for them. The Instant Glow Edit brings together five skincare essentials designed to cleanse, exfoliate, hydrate and refresh the complexion before a big night out. From smoothing away dull surface skin to delivering an instant hydration boost and a cooling facial massage, it's everything they need for that fresh, polished feeling - at home. And because we've built it around a skin goal rather than a skin type, you don't need to know her entire skincare routine to get it right. You know the friend. We’ve made the skincare bit easy.

Inside the Edit

Who it’s for
The pre-party facial lover The one who loves getting ready The skincare-loving friend The one who always has plans The friend who wants her makeup to sit beautifully The one who loves an at-home pamper Suitable for all skin types
How to use
Cleanse Off Mitt Wet with warm water and gently sweep over the face to remove makeup, SPF and daily build-up. Rinse thoroughly and leave to air dry. Before a night out: Use as the first step to get your skin clean and ready for your skincare routine. AHA! Cleanse® Apply to damp skin and gently massage over the face, avoiding the eye area. Rinse thoroughly with warm water. Use: 2-3 evenings a week, depending on your skin's tolerance. Enzyme Powder Polish Pour a small amount into your palm and activate with water. Gently massage over damp skin, avoiding the eye area, then rinse thoroughly. Use alone or add a sprinkle to AHA Cleanse 2-3 times a week to power up your exfoliating action. Hydra-Hit Instant Facial Mask After cleansing, unfold the mask and apply to the face. Leave for 15 minutes, then remove and gently massage the remaining serum into the skin. Before a night out: Use as your hydration step before makeup for skin that feels quenched, soft and refreshed. Limited Edition Cryo Ball After cleansing and applying your skincare, gently glide the Cryo Ball over the face using light, outward and upward movements. Before a night out: Use for a few minutes as the final step of your skincare prep, focusing on areas that look tired or puffy.
Key ingredients
Papaya Enzymes: Help exfoliate the skin's surface, lifting away the look of dull, dead skin cells for a smoother-looking complexion. Calamine: Known for its soothing properties, calamine helps make Enzyme Powder Polish a gentle-feeling exfoliating step. Lactic Acid: An AHA that exfoliates the skin's surface while helping to support hydration, leaving skin feeling smoother and looking more even. PHA: A gentle exfoliating acid that helps remove dead skin cells while attracting moisture to the skin. Glycerine: A humectant that helps draw moisture into the skin, leaving skin feeling hydrated and comfortable. Niacinamide: A form of vitamin B3 that helps support the skin barrier and improve the appearance of uneven-looking skin. Panthenol: Also known as provitamin B5, panthenol helps condition the skin and leave it feeling soft, comfortable and hydrated.
Tips & tricks
Plan your facial moment. Use Hydra-Hit for 15 minutes while you're doing your hair, choosing an outfit or simply taking a moment before getting ready. Bring on the chill. Use the Cryo Ball after your skincare for a cooling facial massage, focusing on the cheeks, jawline and areas that look tired or puffy. Give your skin a little time. Complete your skincare prep before applying makeup, giving each layer a moment to settle. Keep it simple. You don't need to use every product in the Edit every time. Think of it as a collection of facial-inspired steps you can use according to what your skin needs.

Consistency and gradual introduction are key.
